description: Get the current price of coins (by CoinGecko ID) in the given vs currencies, optionally with 24h change.

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko coin IDs to price, e.g. 'bitcoin,ethereum'.

include_24hr_change.description: When true, include each coin's 24-hour price change in the result.

vs_currencies.description: Comma-separated currency codes to price the coins in, e.g. 'usd,eur'.

name: get_price
